source_quality_scale.4: official primary source or official catalogue; current legal duty, reporting contract, measured statistic, operational method or service control verified
source_quality_scale.3: official source with a material live snapshot, provisional classification, revision, sector threshold, target-versus-result or scope caveat

quality_guards: Emergency video relay call and download counts are time-stamped service-usage snapshots.
Digital landline emergency access depends on provider assessment and power-cut backup arrangements.
Custody death classifications can be revised after inquests and quarterly death figures are volatile.
Deaths, self-harm and assaults in custody use different ending periods and require population denominators.
AmbSYS and AmbCO have different publication lags and CSV extracts omit time-series footnotes.
Ambulance management-information files are kept separate from accredited AQI statistics.
A Category 2 response-time target is not represented as an achieved measured result.
Workplace transport, violence and lone-working controls depend on actual work activities rather than land attributes.
NIS reporting applicability and thresholds are sector and impact specific.
ICO guidance marked under review after the Data (Use and Access) Act requires current rechecking.
National Resilience Standards support good practice but do not create new legal duties.
Custody, ambulance, workplace, cyber and emergency-planning information is not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
Current official-source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
